conclusion: The v10 score does not predict channel-relative Shorts performance. Adding middle examples does not neutralize a shortcut that already knows the polar buckets, so performance consistency remains an auxiliary diagnostic rather than Judge validity evidence.

The 94-row input lacks a uniformly constructed compact longform overview.
